breaking.change: Backdrop sampling is off by default, including glass panels, tooltips, HUD frames and standalone backdrop-filter chains; floating surfaces keep readable near-opaque fills.
breaking.fix: Opt in once with the style root --glass-backdrop: auto or UiDesc.glassBackdrop. Explicit none overrides the style and null inherits it. Use @media (-og-glass-backdrop: auto) for thinner on-state fills. Reduced transparency always disables sampling.
